tables.name: Skgurr Naming Method
tables.description: Which naming method a Skgurr settlement name uses. Each result is a naming method; its faces are its weight (starter weights 70% / 30%). Weathered coastal and highland style.

results.name: Geographic Compound
results.description: First element + second element as one word, e.g. Dunwick, Greyhaven.

results.name: Historical Founder
results.description: Founder's name + 's + a settlement feature, e.g. Fergus's Point, Morven's Cove.
